howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw gains a WhatsApp channel: it can send and receive one-on-one messages. The setup automatically copies the adapter, registers it, and installs dependencies.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel, e.g., by saying 'connect WhatsApp' or 'add a WhatsApp channel'.
